about.d: ANAGEM brings together Moroccan geographers and everyone interested in geography. It shares information on the geography of Morocco and organises lectures, seminars, study days, field trips and exhibitions.
join.d: Join our network and take part in ANAGEM's scientific community. The statutes provide for several member categories: active, corresponding, honorary and student.
